brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Full bases piece:1,0,0, piece:1,0,1 and piece:1,0,2 stacked at levels 0, 1 and 2, joined by snap:1,0,0 and snap:1,0,1.

There are two drawers at level 0: drawer:0#0,0#cut (classic, in half base piece:0,0,0;half-n) and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf). They sit beside the tower's bottom base, not inside it, because drawers need a half base and the configurator won't stack bases on a half base. I couldn't add a joint bolt (none offered), so it's not confirmed that the half base is fixed to the tower.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,2~hex-bin-full in the level-2 base, with no cover on top. Collision check clear.

finish.summary: I built the tower and it passes the checks (no rule errors, collision check clear), but it's not a single straight column with drawers built into its bottom storey. The configurator only lets a base be stacked on a full base. A drawer can only go in a half base, and a half base can't have anything stacked on it. So the tower is a stack of three full bases at q1,r0 (levels 0, 1 and 2, joined by snaps). The drawers sit beside the bottom storey, at ground level: a classic drawer in a half base at q0,r0 and a notch drawer frame at q1,-1. There is an open full-depth bin (hex-bin-full, no cover) in the top storey. 9 parts in total. I couldn't add a joint bolt between the half base and the tower because the configurator offered no place for one, so I can't confirm the half base is fixed to the tower.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
